newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TECHNIHIRE WARNS OF POSSIBLE LOSSES.
newsitem.headline: TECHNIHIRE WARNS OF POSSIBLE LOSSES.

text.p: Technihire Ltd warned on Wednesday that it had significant debtors who may not be in a position to repay monies due to the firm in full or within a reasonable period of time and could lead to losses in the company.
Technihire said its holding company, ADECCO, would ensure that sufficient working capital would at all times be made available for the firm to continue its normal operations.
Shareholders were advised to exercise caution in their sharedealings until a further announcement quantifying the effect on the company was made.
